issues.title: Autopilot core: Linux sshd /proc/<pid>/cwd EACCES leaves ended jobs stuck in END and blocks ready issues
issues.bottleneck: Four ended jobs on pdd-vm stayed in END for 72 ticks (12 hours) when /proc/<pid>/cwd returned EACCES, blocking all 4 worker slots.

issues.title: Daily Autopilot conversion analyzer: publish scorecard to stats branch and auto-file verified drop causes
issues.bottleneck: Daily scorecards and drop root-cause tracking lived only in local folders without shared history or automated conversion-drop analysis.

issues.title: Story quality lint: require user-level durable Stories and forbid prompts under test/**
issues.bottleneck: Feature conversion lagged at 61.9% partly due to implementation-level Stories and prompts created for test files.

issues.title: pdd keeps a pool of the person's own Codex and Claude Code logins, and switches to the next one at the usage limit
issues.bottleneck: Account credit and quota exhaustion caused 8 released jobs (Rel = 6.6%) and paused intake until manual account rotation.

issues.title: pdd autopilot start keeps the saved agent account and ignores a new one
issues.bottleneck: Restarting Autopilot with a fresh login kept the previous exhausted account unless config was edited separately.

issues.title: Autopilot core: a stopped job leaves child processes running, because no SIGKILL goes to the process group
issues.bottleneck: Stopped jobs left orphaned child processes holding machine resources and worktree handles.

issues.title: A person keeps running an old pdd after a release, and nothing updates it or tells them
issues.bottleneck: Machines remained on stale PDD binaries across releases, while held PR #3303 made uncached GitHub API calls on every CLI command.

issues.title: Autopilot reports must be real before they are filed: owner, proof, duplicate check, then file automatically
issues.bottleneck: 33 local draft reports accumulated on pdd-vm because unvalidated reports previously mixed quota noise with real PDD and Runtime defects.
